nodes.short_description: Plongez dans Infinite Wave, une invasion de robots en réalité mixte, chez vous. Scannez votre espace, abritez-vous derrière vos meubles et survivez à des vagues de robots sans fin avec des pistolets à plasma, le Gravity Glove, le pistolet électrique Tempest et des tourelles sur vos murs. Choisissez votre défi, de RIPPLE à TSUNAMI, et grimpez dans les classements. Configurez bien votre pièce pour une expérience optimale et préparez-vous à défendre votre réalité.

Tauche ein in Infinite Wave, eine Roboter-Invasion in Mixed Reality, mitten in deinem Zimmer. Scanne deinen Raum, nutze deine Möbel als Deckung und überlebe endlose Roboterwellen mit Plasmawaffen, dem Gravity Glove, der Elektropistole Tempest und Geschützen an deinen Wänden. Wähle deine Herausforderung von RIPPLE bis TSUNAMI und erobere die Bestenlisten. Richte deinen Raum genau ein, damit das Erlebnis perfekt wird, und verteidige deine Realität.

Entre em Infinite Wave, uma invasão de robôs em realidade mista dentro da sua casa. Escaneie seu espaço, use os móveis como cobertura e sobreviva a ondas infinitas de robôs com pistolas de plasma, a Gravity Glove, a pistola elétrica Tempest e torretas nas suas paredes. Escolha seu desafio, de RIPPLE a TSUNAMI, e suba nos rankings. Configure bem seu ambiente para ter a melhor experiência e prepare-se para defender a sua realidade.

Entra in Infinite Wave, un'invasione di robot in realtà mista nella tua stanza. Scansiona il tuo spazio, riparati dietro i mobili e sopravvivi a ondate infinite di robot con pistole al plasma, il Gravity Glove, la pistola elettrica Tempest e torrette sulle tue pareti. Scegli la sfida, da RIPPLE a TSUNAMI, e scala le classifiche. Configura con cura la tua stanza per vivere al meglio l'esperienza e preparati a difendere la tua realtà.

Step into Infinite Wave, a mixed reality robot invasion in your own room. Scan your space, turn your furniture into cover and survive endless waves of robots with plasma guns, a gravity glove, the Tempest electric gun and turrets on your walls. Pick your challenge from RIPPLE to TSUNAMI and climb the leaderboards. Set up your room accurately for the best experience and get ready to defend your reality.

Adéntrate en Infinite Wave, una invasión de robots en realidad mixta dentro de tu propia habitación. Escanea tu espacio, cúbrete tras tus muebles y sobrevive a oleadas interminables de robots con pistolas de plasma, el Gravity Glove, la pistola eléctrica Tempest y torretas en tus paredes. Elige tu desafío, de RIPPLE a TSUNAMI, y escala en las clasificaciones. Configura bien tu habitación para disfrutar al máximo y prepárate para defender tu realidad.

nodes.long_description:
# Infinite Wave

**Infinite Wave** is a mixed reality **survival shooter** that transforms your
real room into a battlefield.

Using Meta Quest’s room setup, your walls, furniture, and space become
part of the game. Take cover behind your couch, move around your table,
and defend your environment against relentless waves of robotic enemies.

{1452957722497118}

Designed specifically for mixed reality, Infinite Wave blends digital
action with your physical space, creating a unique experience every time
you play.

{2687987704919603}

# Key Features
-   **Mixed Reality gameplay** in your real environment
-   **Endless waves** of increasingly challenging robots
-   **Physical movement** and positioning for survival
-   **Score** system and competitive leaderboard
-   **Clean sci-fi visuals** designed for comfort and clarity

# Important
-   Complete an accurate Room Setup
-   Include all major furniture for best results
-   This allows enemies and effects to properly interact with your space

# Early Access / Alpha
-   Infinite Wave is actively evolving with new features and
    improvements
-   Your feedback is important to shape the experience
-   Please share feedback or report issues via email

# Objective
1.  Defend your space
2.  Adapt to the waves
3.  Push your limits

nodes.change_log:
INFINITE WAVE 1.2.0: TEMPEST AND THREE LEVELS

Choose your wave
• Three difficulty levels: RIPPLE (a gentler start), SURGE (the classic Infinite Wave) and TSUNAMI (more robots, tougher and faster).
• After Play, pick your level, then a checkpoint or A NEW START. Every level has its own checkpoints and its own leaderboard. Your SURGE checkpoints and scores carry over.

Tempest, the electric gun
• Clear wave 15 and it's yours. Hold the trigger: the ray locks onto a robot, shocks it and jumps to the ones around it.
• Shocked robots freeze where they are, even on your walls and ceiling, until the first one goes down.

Your language
• Infinite Wave now speaks German, French, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. It follows your headset's language; change it in Settings → General Settings.

Fixes
• Energy and shield cells no longer disappear when you move a turret onto them.
• Clearer missing-permission page, weapon swap hint and turret tutorial.
• FEEDBACK & SUPPORT on the lobby news board now opens our website.

Thank you for every review and every message: keep them coming!

New: the Gravity Glove (unlocks after wave 7)

* With an empty hand, pull the trigger to grab an enemy with a gravity beam. Smash it into your walls, furniture and other enemies, or throw it. Impact kills score double.
* Slingshot: while you hold an enemy, pull the thumbstick back to charge, then let go to launch it.
* Tear enemies apart: grab the same enemy with both gloves and pull.
* A new tutorial page explains it all.

Improvements and fixes

* The game pauses when the headset goes to sleep, comes off, or the system menu opens.
* Turrets no longer keep shooting a bomb bot that has blown up, or get stuck on an enemy they can’t hit.
* The energy cell’s buttons move with your squeeze again.
* Bomb bot scoring fixed.

Version 1.1.2: more fronts, more firepower, a new flying enemy
NEW
• Drone Bot: a flying enemy from wave 46. It hovers around you, darts between positions and fires from the air. Shoot it down, or punch it out of the sky.
• More fronts: a second cave opens at wave 35 and a third at wave 60, so enemies come at you from several directions.
• Two new turrets: MK IV with twin gatlings after wave 40, and MK V, a long-range plasma cannon, after wave 50.
• New checkpoints: Two Fronts, Bullet Storm, Eyes in the Sky, Full Arsenal and Three Fronts.
• New tutorial page for the Drone Bot.
SMOOTHER
• Steadier frame rate in big waves: robots are much lighter to draw, and effects scale down automatically when the action gets heavy.
• No more hitch when grabbing or swapping weapons.
• Rooms and caves load much faster.
FIXES
• Turrets now land on open floor: no more turrets on furniture, hidden inside it, or stacked on top of each other when playing outdoors.
• Shield Bot legs no longer stay stuck on walls or the ceiling, and debris rarely falls through the floor.
• The laser turret's beam looks right at any distance.

Infinite Wave 1.1.0 – The Turret Update

New

Three turret types (cannon, laser, twin cannons), unlocked at waves 10, 20 and 30
Energy: collect yellow cells to upgrade turrets (3 levels) and repair them
Enemies now attack your turrets too
New checkpoint after wave 30
Holoshield shortcut: press A or X

Improved
Smoother hand movement
More reliable room loading and a quicker Space Setup / Edit flow
Better performance with several turrets
New holoshield look; destroyed robots go up in smoke

* Complete UI redesign with improved layouts, readability, and visual consistency
* Added Shield Bot, a new enemy capable of protecting nearby units with an energy shield
* Optimized rendering, UI, and gameplay systems for improved performance and frame stability
